description.value: Hiellen Village Longhouses is an Indigenous-owned campground on the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, operated by the Old Massett Village Council on traditional Haida lands, steps from North Beach. The site offers six small cedar longhouses (each sleeping up to 4 with indoor bathroom, gas stovetop, and wood-burning fireplace), a group longhouse sleeping 20+, and tent and RV sites. Built using wood milled locally by community apprentices, all profits are reinvested into the Old Massett Village Council to support local employment and cultural preservation.

address.value: 29997 Tow Hill Road, Masset, BC V0T 1R0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is an active campground offering six small longhouses (indoor bathroom, gas stovetop, wood-burning fireplace, sleeps 4), a group longhouse (sleeps 20+), and tent/RV sites on northern Haida Gwaii. Neither the website nor OSM content mentions secure bike storage, staff bike procedures, laundry, drying rooms, or any cyclist-specific facilities, so those remain null. The OSM internet_access=wlan tag is not corroborated by any website text, so Wi-Fi is marked null per the rules. Both phone numbers on the website match the OSM tags exactly.
concerns: OSM beds:4 is inconsistent with website, which describes 6 small longhouses (up to 4 guests each) plus a group longhouse sleeping 20+ and additional tent/RV sites — the OSM bed count is significantly understated.
Contact page contains unfilled Lorem Ipsum placeholder text, suggesting incomplete site maintenance.
Active construction is ongoing — website states 'We are constructing 7 Longhouses at the Hiellen Village' and warns of construction noise during stays.
Website address uses 'Towhill Rd' (no house number) while OSM uses '29997 Tow Hill Road'; both reference the same location but spelling and number differ.
Small longhouses explicitly state no bedding or towels provided; self-supported cyclists should be aware they must carry their own.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating accommodation on a remote cycling route in Haida Gwaii, but neither the website nor OSM provides any evidence of secure bike storage (a required WWC criterion). Direct outreach is needed to confirm whether cyclists' bikes can be stored securely overnight.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address found on website (not in OSM): hiellenlonghouses@gmail.com. Small longhouses have no refrigerator; the group longhouse has a full-size fridge and fully stocked kitchen. Mailing address is C/O Old Massett Village Council, P.O. Box 189, Masset BC V0T 1M0.
